about: Every window the UI draws with `egui::Window::new` in crates/ui-egui/src, found by the file and the function that draws it.
A modal takes the keyboard and the pointer while it is up: `keyboard::modal_open` counts it, it holds egui's modal layer, and the
survey test (`tests_dialogs.rs`) has a row for it (`survey`, else `name`). An exception stays out of the way on purpose: `reason` says why.

`count`: how many windows the function draws, when more than one. `notModalWhen`: a modal that isn't one at those times. `id`: the window's egui id, `Id::new` of the first, then `.with` of each other;
with it, the UI tests fail on a modal shown while `keyboard::modal_open` is false. `cargo xtask windows` (a step of `ci`) checks the list.
